card.name: Dose adjustment wording in dosing sections
card.fires_on: Words in dosing instructions that lead into how a dose is adjusted, such as "based on", "depending on", "titrate", "highest tolerated" and "discontinuation". It fires in the dosage and administration section.

modes.label: Based or depending on
modes.description: The word "on" after "based" or "depending", introducing the response or tolerability that guides the dose.
modes.example: Increase to 20 mg or decrease to 5 mg based<< on>> efficacy/tolerability.

modes.label: Titrate and tolerated
modes.description: Part of the words titrate or tolerated, in instructions to adjust the dose step by step.
modes.example: Initiate dosing with one half of the recommended starting dosage and<< tit>>rate carefully.

modes.label: Stopping or increasing
modes.description: Words about stopping or raising therapy, such as discontinuation or increase.
modes.example: In such patients, consider discontin<<uation>> of REXULTI at the first
